issues.description: The problem statement text (line 50) incorrectly specifies addGuestStudents(String) while the UML and the intended implementation use addGuestStudents(int). This parameter type mismatch can confuse students about what type to accept and how to update the number of guest students.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the problem statement text to consistently specify addGuestStudents(int) (e.g., addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents)) so it matches the UML and intended implementation, or alternatively adjust the UML and solution if the method should accept a String.

issues.description: The problem statement erroneously refers to addGuestStudents(String) (line 50) while the UML diagram and the reference solution expect addGuestStudents(int). This mismatch in the described method signature creates ambiguity for students about whether to implement a method that accepts a String or an int and may lead to incorrect implementations or test mismatches.
issues.suggestedFix: Correct the problem statement to specify addGuestStudents(int) to match the UML and the reference implementation (or alternatively update UML and solution if the intended parameter type is String). Preferably change the textual instruction from addGuestStudents(String) to addGuestStudents(int) so all artifacts consistently use an int parameter.
